-- Phase 1: spec for checked 64-bit signed addition.
-- Returns None when a + b does not fit in int. Never overflows.

checked_add(a: int, b: int) -> int? =
  post out == None or out == a + b
  ex checked_add(1, 2) == 3
  ex checked_add(-1, 1) == 0
  ex checked_add(9223372036854775807, 1) == None
  let max = 9223372036854775807
  let min = -9223372036854775807 - 1
  if b > 0 and a > max - b
    return None
  if b < 0 and a < min - b
    return None
  a + b
